ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, authorized representatives, and material counterparties must be screened before filing against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK HMT Sanctions List, and the domestic terrorist-entities list maintained by the Egyptian Public Prosecutor and the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit. Politically Exposed Persons are identified under the definition in the Executive Regulations of Law No. 80 of 2002 and are subject to enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and senior-management approval. Screening must be refreshed at least every 90 days and immediately before each high-value SWIFT or escrow-funded transaction.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Company Establishment and Name Clearance Portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) in coordination with the Egyptian Commercial Registry (Ministry of Trade and Industry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be in Arabic script. Foreign-language names or phrases require a statutory Arabic transliteration matched to the certified foreign incorporation documents or passport. An English phonetic transliteration may appear in parentheses, but it must not cause confusion or divergence from the approved Arabic name. The name must be distinctive, not misleading, not identical or confusingly similar to an existing Egyptian company, and must reflect the permitted wholesale and brokerage activities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon administrative rejection, the applicant receives a written refusal notice stating the grounds. The applicant may file a written appeal with the Legal Affairs Directorate of GAFI within ten business days, providing evidence of distinctiveness, non-conflict, and compliance with Companies Law No. 159/1981 and Investment Law No. 72/2017. GAFI must decide the appeal within fifteen business days. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may file a second administrative complaint to the Ministerial Grievance Committee within thirty days, and thereafter may initiate a petition before the Egyptian Administrative Court within sixty days from the final refusal. In practice, the applicant should simultaneously file a fresh reservation with an alternative transliteration or corporate designator to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a standalone registered office. GAFI and the Egyptian Commercial Registry require a physical Egyptian seat evidenced by a registered lease agreement and the ability to receive official notifications and legal process. A licensed serviced office with an assigned physical suite, reception personnel, and a lease agreement may satisfy the requirement; a pure virtual address or mail-forwarding service will be rejected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 55% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 36 months of operation, reflecting the enhanced Medium-Risk AML/CFT classification for semiconductor/electronics wholesale and routine tax and commercial registry verification controls.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (Articles 1-21 and 102-109 on Limited Liability Companies), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (Articles 70-77 on the GAFI one-stop-shop); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — Companies Registration One-Stop-Shop (exclusive window for foreign and domestic incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association (عقد تأسيس الشركة ونظامها الأساسي) duly notarized before the Ministry of Justice Notary Public and submitted for commercial registration on the GAFI LLC incorporation form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an LLC under Egyptian law; the capital is divided into equal-value quotas fully subscribed by the members and collectible per the payment schedule in the Articles of Association. No escrow account is mandatory; subscription proceeds are held in a temporary corporate bank account released only upon issuance of the Commercial Register Extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association, as registered with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), be and are hereby ratified and adopted in full; RESOLVED, that the quota-share subscription of the founding members is approved and treated as fully paid in accordance with the Articles; RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the premises stated in the Articles, and the Directors are authorized to execute lease, utility, and civil-defense registrations; RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed General Manager with authority to open bank accounts, sign trade contracts, and clear imported goods; the Chairman and any one Director act jointly as alternate signatories; RESOLVED, that the Chairman complete tax registration and appoint the statutory auditor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Activity Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop — Name Reservation Desk (online portal: www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application reserving three ranked corporate names and confirming that the approved activities (wholesale brokerage of SSDs and server processors, ISIC 4651) are on the GAFI permitted activity list. The commercial name must end with the LLC suffix or its Arabic equivalent and must not conflict with reserved trademarks or existing registrations. The GAFI examiner issues a preliminary activity clearance stating that no sector-specific license is required beyond the commercial register.
required_dossiers: GAFI name reservation application form (Form GA-01)
Certified passport copies of all founding members
Notarized power of attorney if a founder is a legal entity or represented by an agent
National ID or passport of the authorized signatory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict, select the next alternative from the ranked list and re-file the same day; if the activity is queried, submit a cover letter describing the exact ISIC classification and obtain a GAFI activity reclassification decision within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Incorporation Contract and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Authority, Ministry of Justice (Document Authentication Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the incorporation contract and articles of association before a licensed notary public, ensuring that each founding member or his authorized representative signs in the presence of the notary and that the authenticated deed records the quota capital, share of each member, registered office address, and management powers. After authentication, obtain the certified copies and the notary's registration number for submission to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation contract and Articles of Association in Arabic (minimum three original copies)
GAFI name reservation certificate (original)
Passports or national IDs of all founding members
Minutes of the founders' subscription meeting
Evidence of registered office address (lease deed or utility bill)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the deed for corrections, cure any drafting or signature discrepancies and re-attest the corrected copy within 7 days; if one founder fails to appear, hold a supplementary subscription hearing or substitute a new member by a supplemental deed prior to re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop Incorporation and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop — Commercial Registry Department (internal coordination with the General Commercial Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized incorporation contract through the GAFI one-stop-shop window; GAFI verifies the deed, extracts the company's electronic file, and issues the initial Commercial Register Extract automatically after ministerial data checks (state security, commercial registry conflicts, and capital confirmation). The one-stop-shop simultaneously notifies the Egyptian Tax Authority and the Central Bank of Egypt of the new entity.
required_dossiers: Notarized incorporation contract and Articles of Association (original plus two certified copies)
GAFI standard incorporation application executed by the General Manager
Bank certificate of temporary capital deposit (if capital is paid in cash)
Lease contract of the registered office with landlord's title deed
Passport-size photographs and specimen signatures of all authorized managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: GAFI issues a deficiency notice (طلب استيفاء) listing missing documents or capital clarifications; cure the deficiency within 14 calendar days by uploading or physically submitting the corrected file; if the application is rejected on substantive grounds, file a written internal reassessment request with GAFI's Registration Grievance Department within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Issuance of the Tax Card
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — Central Tax Registration Department (via GAFI one-stop-shop data transfer)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the ETA tax-card application using the pre-populated data received from GAFI; ETA issues the tax card (بطاقة ضريبية) evidencing corporate income tax, value-added tax, and payroll tax registration. The company must also request price-verification and VAT certificate details for the wholesale trade activity; the tax card is the essential precondition for customs clearance and bank transfers.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register Extract (original stamped copy)
Incorporation contract and Articles of Association (certified copy)
ETA tax-card application form (signed by the legal representative)
Registered lease contract of the office and warehouse
Specimen signature cards of authorized officers
National ID of the legal representative and tax-file authorization letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA queries the tax file, submit documentation of the premises inspection and clarify the expected annual turnover; if the tax card is withheld due to inconsistent data, obtain a GAFI reconciliation note and re-file within 10 working days; an administrative appeal is available to the ETA Internal Review Committee within 30 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Capital Deposit Release
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Egypt (operations supervised by the Central Bank of Egypt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the company's current and collection accounts presenting the authenticated incorporation contract, commercial register extract, tax card, and the first board resolution appointing the General Manager. The bank completes customer due diligence on the Ultimate Beneficial Owners and the board resolution on authorized signatories; the temporary capital deposit account, if any, is converted into the permanent corporate operating account upon registration.
required_dossiers: Authenticated incorporation contract and Commercial Register Extract
Original tax card
Certified copy of the First Board Resolution appointing the General Manager
Specimen signatures of all authorized signatories
Ultimate Beneficial Owner declaration and source-of-funds questionnaire
Trade contract or supplier pro-forma invoice confirming the semiconductor wholesale activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's compliance department requests further KYC data, provide a notarized ownership chart and board resolution updates within 5 working days; there is no statutory cure, so the applicant may select an alternative licensed bank without re-registering the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Importer Registration at the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) — Importers Registration Department, Ministry of Trade and Industry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the importer registration application (قيد في سجل المستوردين) so that the company obtains the statutory right to clear SSD and CPU chip shipments through Egyptian customs. The application is screened for compliant capital, commercial activity alignment, and a valid tax card; upon approval, GOEIC issues the Importer Registration Certificate, which must be renewed annually and allows the company to obtain import letters of credit and customs release.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register Extract (approved and stamped)
Current tax card (original)
GOEIC importer registration application (Form imported-register official form)
Certified copy of the warehouse or registered-office lease
Criminal record extract of the General Manager
Proof of Egyptian nationality or majority Egyptian ownership of the LLC's quota capital
Receipt of the GOEIC registration fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GOEIC rejects the application for mismatched activity codes, request an amendment of the commercial register scope at GAFI and resubmit within 15 days; a formal administrative appeal may also be lodged with the Ministry of Trade and Industry within 30 days of the denial notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense License and Premises Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Administration of Civil Defense, Ministry of Interior — in coordination with the Municipal Zoning and Licensing Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the civil defense fire-safety license for the registered office and any storage warehouse by scheduling an inspection of the premises for fire extinguishers, emergency exits, electrical-load safety, and smoke-detection systems. After the inspection, submit the clearance certificate together with occupational-health registration to the Ministry of Manpower for warehouse operations; a separate municipal building-confirmation is required confirming the site's commercial/warehousing zoning.
required_dossiers: Civil defense license application form
Lease contract and copy of the landlord's title deed for the premises
Building construction plans and structural-load certificate
Proof of installation of fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and exit signage
Occupational health registration form under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003
Municipal commercial-use and land-use clearance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the civil defense inspection identifies code violations, remedy the listed deficiencies (additional extinguishers, new electrical circuit boxes, exit widening) and request re-inspection within 14 days; if the municipality denies the land-use clearance, apply for a special usage permit or relocate the warehouse to a pre-zoned logistics/industrial parcel and re-file the application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) — Importers Registration Department, Ministry of Trade and Industry; commercial supervision by GAFI Commercial Registry Department; no industrial manufacturing license is required for pure wholesale storage and brokerage trading.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Importer Registration Certificate (سجل المستوردين) together with the Commercial Register Extract (كشف السجل التجاري) issued under Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment, operating under Environmental Protection Law No. 4 of 1994, as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C — Registration/Screening only; sealed-warehouse wholesale distribution of SSD and CPU components is not on the mandatory EIA list, so a brief environmental self-screening form is filed and no full Environmental Impact Assessment report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No production wastewater or VOC emission sources arise from the activity; sanitary sewage must comply with applicable wastewater quality limits under Law No. 48 of 1982 and Decree No. 44 of 2000 for discharge into public sewer; end-of-life SSDs and processors are classified as electronic waste, and their handling and transfer to licensed recyclers must follow Law No. 4 of 1994 and Ministerial Decree No. 573 of 2015 on e-waste management.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil-defense fire-safety license from the Ministry of Interior (General Administration of Civil Defense) requiring fire-extinguisher placement, emergency egress, electrical-load compliance, and smoke detection for the storage warehouse; occupational health and workplace clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, including medical surveillance and safety planning for warehouse operations; municipal structural-load and land-use inspection confirming the commercial/warehousing zoning of the registered office and storage site.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — National Integrated Tax System and electronic invoicing/clearance portal at https://eta.gov.eg and https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must be incorporated through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and then register with the ETA within 30 days of commercial registration or, for inbound non-resident activity, within 30 days of the first taxable supply, permanent establishment creation, or entry into an Egyptian-source taxable contract. The LLC submits its constitutional documents, board resolution, power-of-attorney, lease/title deed, business license, tax office address form, and certified copies of directors' IDs/passports; the ETA issues the Tax Card containing the Corporate Income Tax Number, VAT registration number, and withholding tax code, together with registration in the National Integrated Tax System.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available for Egyptian LLCs. Egypt applies entity-level taxation to LLCs under Corporate Tax Law No. 91 of 2005, as amended by Law No. 30 of 2023. A resident LLC is taxed on worldwide income at the standard corporate rate; deductible expense, depreciation, inventory valuation, and loss-carry-forward elections are available under articles 25-40 of Law 91/2005, but no pass-through or look-through election exists absent an approved joint venture arrangement.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2023, complemented by ETA e-invoicing and e-receipts regulations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable supply of goods or services; imports are subject to VAT irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-registered businesses must issue e-invoices and credit notes in real-time to the ETA through the mandatory e-invoicing platform using ETA-approved XML/JSON schemas via REST/SOAP APIs. Each invoice must receive an ETA-generated Unique Identifier (UUID) and validation code and carry a QR-compatible barcode. Since the B2C e-receipts mandate entered into force on a phased schedule, wholesale distributors, including semiconductor chip and SSD traders, must also transmit electronic receipts to the ETA for applicable direct-to-consumer sales. The system is a pre-clearance, validity-authentication regime, not merely an archiving obligation; rejected invoices stop the transaction for VAT credit/refund purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Egypt to destinations outside the customs territory, including SSD and CPU processor stock sold for international markets, qualify for 0% VAT provided the exporter is VAT-registered, the goods leave Egypt under a valid customs export declaration, the ETA e-invoice is issued before or on shipment, and export proceeds are received in Egypt in convertible foreign currency within the statutory repatriation period. Offshore services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Egypt and paid in externally transferable currencies may also qualify for zero-rating under ETA circulars.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (NAFEZA Single Administrative Document and customs manifest)
Bill of Lading or electronic Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Egypt
Inward Remittance Certificate showing export proceeds credited through the Egyptian banking system
Commercial invoice and signed sale/purchase contract
ETA-validated e-invoice or credit note with QR/XML file
Certificate of Origin and packing list
Customs transit/terminal movement records if applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA, Customs Authority, and Central Bank of Egypt may jointly audit all export zero-rating claims. If documentation is incomplete, false, or the export is shown not to have physically occurred, the taxpayer loses the 0% rate, is reassessed for VAT at 14%, and is charged statutory late-payment interest (currently 2% per month compounded). Fraudulent invoices or false customs declarations expose the taxpayer to fines equal to the full tax due, additional discretionary penalties of up to EGP 50,000, potential criminal enforcement, 3-7 years imprisonment for customs evasion, and retrospective clawback of refunded input VAT when export proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), operating in coordination with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Egyptian Customs Authority for trade-related foreign exchange verification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) operates under a managed-float exchange-rate regime unified in March 2024. Current-account transactions, including payment for imported SSD/CPU chips, ancillary logistics, and servicing of trade finance facilities, are freely executable at the interbank rate and require no prior CBE approval. Capital-account transactions, including equity injections, intercompany shareholder loans, and repatriation of invested capital, are permissible but must be documented through CBE-designated reporting forms and the bank's Foreign Direct Investment desk; dividends and profits may be remitted abroad, subject to presentation of audited financial statements certified by an Egyptian licensed auditor, a tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority, and approved minutes of the general assembly confirming the distributable reserve computation. Residual practical hurdles for profit remittance include extended verification timelines (5 to 15 business days), the requirement that a shareholder's funded capital be fully recorded in the CBE FDI database, and enhanced due diligence where the ultimate parent is in a high-risk jurisdiction; these hurdles are manageable with a properly established CBE-registered capital escrow ledger.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE Circular No. 1 of 2022, as amended by the March 2024 foreign-exchange liberalization measures, exporters of semiconductor goods (HS 8471/8473) must repatriate 100% of export proceeds into a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank within 30 days from the bill-of-lading date, with a possible documentary extension up to 90 days where the overseas settlement is demonstrably pending under bank confirmation. The former mandatory 50% conversion of export earnings into EGP has been abolished for proceeds received in convertible currencies; the LLC may retain the full amount in a Foreign Currency Account (USD/EUR) and deploy it for import cover of the same trade cycle, subject to CBE bank-level reporting via the monthly Foreign Currency Position statement. Where proceeds are received after 90 days without an approved extension, the bank is required to flag the account to CBE and apply the standard delay-survey procedure; pre-approval through the CBE Trade Registry and alignment of the export contract number with the invoice avoid the application of surrender-penalty measures.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_note: The 30-day repatriation window is computed from the date of the export declaration in the ACID (Advanced Cargo Information) platform; proceeds retained in USD may be used directly for the settlement of a matching import LC under the same CBE-licensed bank, thereby avoiding double-conversion cost.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.capital_account_registration_requirement: Prior to the first dividend remittance or capital repatriation, the LLC's equity structure and each shareholder's identities must be uploaded to the CBE Foreign Direct Investment database through the onboarding bank; without this registration the bank cannot execute the MT103 profit-remittance instruction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.current_account_invoice_matching_rule: For trade payments exceeding USD 50,000 per transaction, the CBE-licensed bank must receive an electronic copy of the commercial invoice, the ACID import declaration, and the underlying purchase order; the bank will verify the amount, beneficiary name, and purpose code before releasing the wire, thus requiring a straight-through documentation workflow from invoice generation to bank portal submission.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (EGP/USD) and Operational Collections Account
Operational Account (EGP) and Foreign Currency Account (USD/EUR) for Export Proceeds
Trade Finance Settlement Account (LC / Documentary Collections) linked to EGP current account
Multi-Currency Current Account (EGP/USD/EUR) with Global Money Movement integration
Operational EGP Account with USD sub-account for SWIFT inbound wires

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Alexandria S.A.E. (Intesa Sanpaolo Group)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EGP Account linked to Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) services; USD pass-through account
Treasury EGP/USD Settlement Account for hedging and interbank FX operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Marginal / Not Recommended for Onshore Treasury. Offshore digital EMI platforms (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, and similar) are not licensed by the CBE and cannot lawfully maintain EGP-denominated accounts or provide payment services to Egyptian domiciled companies without a CBE fintech license under Law No. 194 of 2020. An Egyptian LLC utilising offshore EMIs for the receipt of SSD/CPU trade settlement would create an unrecorded and unreported FX inflow event, potentially triggering CBE balance-of-payments penalties and bank account de-risking. A limited and compliant use case exists for the treasury of a non-exporting import-only entity: using an offshore EMI to receive shareholder disbursements outside Egypt and then channelling the funds into Egypt via SWIFT MT103 to a CBE-licensed bank, giving the EMI the character of a pass-through prefunding vehicle only. Onshore fintech payment service providers such as Fawry, Paymob, and Telda require a commercial bank sponsor and do not offer trade finance settlement for wholesale semiconductor imports; therefore, the direct interbank SWIFT MT103 rail is the exclusive compliant settlement channel for the core business.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory, with limited remote pre-onboarding. CBE AML/CFT Rules require corporate account opening to include an in-branch introduction of the directors and ultimate beneficial owners. The bank's Compliance Officer must conduct a live KYC interview in Cairo or Alexandria; the interview is recorded and retained for the 5-year statutory AML period. Remote opening or fully electronic account opening is not permitted for companies with foreign ownership; however, foreign directors may complete pre-account-opening documentation remotely via videoconference, provided the following occurs: (i) the director's identity is verified against a notarized and apostilled passport copy; (ii) the LLC's commercial registration and tax card are authenticated by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs; and (iii) at least one statutory director present in Egypt attends the physical in-branch session to finalise authorisation. The chairman and compliance officer of the LLC must visit Egypt at least once during the 12-month onboarding cycle; where the UBO is an international semiconductor trading group, a sworn declaration by the Egyptian director confirming UBO identity and source-of-wealth is accepted.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wholesale trading in high-value electronic components (SSD/CPU) with a thin capital base and no physical warehouse presence in Egypt
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreements with registered overseas manufacturers; warehouse lease or third-party logistics (3PL) contract; cargo insurance policy; inventory reconciliation reports; purchase orders and the Egypt Customs ACID declaration for each import/export shipment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wire transfers from or to jurisdictions perceived as high-risk (e.g., UAE free zones, Hong Kong trading houses, or jurisdictions under FATF Enhanced Follow-Up) without transparent end-beneficiary disclosure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-beneficiary certificate signed by the overseas counterparty; legal-entity registry extraction (trade register report); invoice with Incoterms 2020 breakdown; transport documents (bill of lading/airway bill); and an anti-circumvention declaration confirming sanctions screening of all parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between ISIC 4651 wholesale classification and a transaction pattern of frequent split payments, third-party settlement, or immediate round-tripping
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Framework purchase agreement with price list; settlement matrix; board resolution approving treasury policy; bank statement reconciliation notes; CBE Trade Registry import/export registration numbers; redacted customer contracts demonstrating real trade flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Profit repatriation or dividend remittance requested within the first 12 months of operation where audited financial statements are not yet available
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements certified by an Egyptian CPA registered with the Egyptian Accountants Syndicate; tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority; CBE FDI registration certificate; shareholders' general-assembly minutes computing distributable profit after the statutory 5% legal reserve; transaction-level confirmation that the dividend source is retained earnings, not paid-in capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Significant same-day EGP cash deposits and onward FX conversion indicating trade-based money laundering or structuring around the bank's monitoring thresholds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow forecast with business rationale; treasury policy document; underlying commercial invoices matched to the bank's transaction references; an irrevocable undertaking from the external auditor to verify settlement against the trade documentation within five business days; training certificate of the compliance officer under the Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Combating Unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Electricity or utility bill mismatch for the registered office in the bank's documentary verification process
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised lease contract of the Egyptian registered office; recent utility bill aligned in name and address; confirmation certificate from the Egyptian Ministry of Trade addressing correspondence with the CBE; official bank-statement delivery confirmation to the registered office for the preceding three months.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant inbound equity injection rail is an SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the overseas shareholder's bank into the LLC's EGP or USD account at a CBE-licensed bank. The remittance instruction must state the purpose code 'P-040' (Foreign Direct Investment - Capital Subscription) and reference the CBE FDI registration certificate and the LLC's commercial registration number. Prior to receipt, the onboarding bank requires a notarised board resolution authorising the shareholder contribution and confirming the account beneficiary; the funds are then credited to the capital escrow ledger, and the bank issues CBE Form FDI-1 for balance-of-payments statistics. Where the shareholder simultaneously advances an intercompany loan, a separate MT103 must quote 'P-041' (Intercompany Loan) and include the CBE-registered loan agreement, maturity profile, and pricing; the bank will apply a one-time loan-registration charge and monitor repayment dates for subsequent outflow matching. Under the March 2024 unified-rate regime, inbound capital received in USD or EUR is convertible into EGP at the interbank mid-market rate without any prior approval, but the bank will require the shareholder's bank to certify that the transfer is from an account holding the shareholder's own funds and not a third-party sourcing arrangement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for SSD/CPU chips are cleared over three compliant rails: (1) Open-account payments via SWIFT MT103 for advance-payment or credit terms, requiring the CBE-licensed receiving bank to hold the underlying invoice, purchase order, and ACID number; these are routed through the bank's correspondent network and settle in USD/EUR at the counterparty's territory. (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) issued under ICC UCP 600, with CBE Import Registry registration, covering the shipment through the presenting bank; the LC documents a bank-to-bank MT700 plus MT720 amendments and provides a settlement mirror to the exporter's build-to-order cycle. (3) Documentary Collections (D/P, D/A) processed through the SWIFT MT400/MT410 series, for which the import shipment is recorded in the CBE trade ledger and released against sight payment or acceptance. For profit repatriation transactions, the dividend wire uses SWIFT MT103 with the purpose code 'P-200' (Dividends and Distributions), accompanied by the CBE dividend remittance form; loan repayments are settled under MT103 with purpose code 'P-042' and are checked against the CBE loan schedule. To enhance liquidity certainty, the treasury should aggregate monthly outbound flows and use a single correspondent corridor (preferably EUR via Germany or USD via New York), maintaining at least 30% of the month-end EGP balance in liquid money-market instruments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore OTC FX forwards with a CBE-licensed bank (physical delivery at the interbank rate; tenor up to 12 months; requires presentation of the underlying import/export commercial documents)
FX swaps for EGP/USD liquidity management with a CBE-licensed bank under the ISDA Master Agreement (maximum 3-month rolling window; no embedded options)
Currency forwards executed on the Nile Stock Exchange's Currency Derivative Segment (only if the LLC holds a derivative eligibility certificate issued by the EGX Clearing House)
Cross-currency swaps (fixed-for-fixed EGP/USD) with a CBE-licensed bank, subject to the bank's internal hedging desk approval and CBE economic-substance review

Physically settled deliverable forwards on USD/EGP are permissible; non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are NOT permissible for onshore corporate accounts as the CBE does not operate an NDF market for real-economy hedging and all instruments must be settled in EGP or a fully remitted convertible currency

Treasury bill-linked FX collar structures are only permissible through a CBE-licensed bank's structured-notes desk and require a documented hedging rationale aligned to the import cover of semiconductor components

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form 100) with Audited Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the financial year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs an additional penalty of 2% per month of the tax payable plus statutory delay interest; continued default may lead to administrative seizure of assets, blocking of the tax clearance certificate, and forced collection enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal and Registered Data Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during January for the preceding calendar year, or on the anniversary month of the initial registration as applied by the local registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment produces incremental fines under Commercial Registry Law 34/1976; non-renewal for more than one year may cause the registration record to be marked inactive and can lead to administrative strike-off or cancellation of the commercial registration certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements and Directors Report Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end; for a December financial year-end, no later than 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file exposes the managers to administrative penalties, blocks issuance of a good-standing certificate, and persistent default may support compulsory winding-up proceedings initiated by creditors or the registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and Economic Ownership Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Egyptian AML/Financial Intelligence Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary of incorporation, and within 30 days of any share transfer or change of beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under AML Law 80/2002, false, incomplete, or late UBO declarations may trigger fines up to EGP 100,000 and criminal liability for directors; the registrar will suspend recognition of the share transfer until the declaration is remediated.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Egyptian LLC, irrespective of size, must appoint an independent registered external auditor and file audited financial statements with the annual corporate tax return; a mandatory statutory audit is expressly required for any LLC with annual turnover above EGP 10 million, or when required by the articles of association or shareholders.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS-aligned Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by the Ministry of Investment; financial statements must be prepared in Arabic, and additional English versions are permitted for foreign counterparties.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC manager must reconfirm the beneficial ownership schedule annually at the ordinary general assembly and update the Economic Ownership Register. Every share quota transfer in the wholesale SSD/CPU trading LLC must be approved by the general assembly, recorded in the Register of Members, and the updated UBO declaration must be filed with the Companies Registry within 30 days of the ownership change; the transfer is not opposable to the company until such registration is completed.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–800 per year for a registered office and corporate agent in Cairo or the Suez Canal Economic Zone
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200–4,500 per year for a private LLC conducting wholesale semiconductor spot trading with moderate transaction volume

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% under Law No. 91 of 2005 (Egyptian Income Tax Law) for juridical persons; a 25% rate applies only to banks and telecommunications companies and does not apply to an SSD/CPU wholesale distribution LLC.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket exemption for trading intermediation. The general effective rate is 22.5% after ordinary deductions for cost of goods sold, freight, customs duties, warehousing, salaries, rent, depreciation, financing costs, and statutory social insurance. Targeted relief may apply under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, including Cabinet-approved tax deductions of up to 50% of invested capital for projects in prioritized sectors or geographical zones, and negotiated 'Golden License' packages; the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) offers separately negotiated tax stabilization packages. For open-market spot brokerage of SSDs and server processors, these investment incentives are generally unavailable without a specific strategic-project designation.
